lines.text: Did you know? Fact is Latin for make or do.
Infect: into plus make or do.
Efficient: out plus make or do.
Quick quiz! Which means out plus make or do?
Efficient! Out plus make or do.

words.ex: The virus can infect both people and animals.
Trains are an efficient way to travel between cities.
